summary.text: O. VÆRING EFTF. AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 1995-03-20. O. VÆRING EFTF. AS engages in trade and related activities; establishing a picture archive and operating and selling from it; buying and selling securities; and holding interests in other enterprises or in real estate. It was previously named FOTOGRAF O VÆRING AS until 1995-09-21. Its main industry code is 74.200: photographic activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 280 371 NOK and the annual result was -16 941 NOK; operating income was up from 258 396 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 21 820 NOK in 2024 to -16 941 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 95 100 NOK in 2024 to 78 159 NOK in 2025.
